note: session.artifacts.v1 wire examples. The app must see session.artifacts.v1 in the projects.list capabilities.v2 route before sending session.artifacts.list or session.artifacts.open. session.artifacts.open answers with the files.media result shape; its path is the logical name artifacts/<artifactId>/<version>.<ext>, never a host path, and the bytes are read with session.files.media.get. text/vnd.mermaid (5 MiB cap) appears only in answers to session.artifacts.open.
